tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: Lists the social media channels connected to this Hookpost workspace, each with its id, name, profile picture and platform identifier. Use this when the user asks which accounts are connected, or to get the channel id and platform that create_post, get_platform_post_rules and the lookup tools need. Pass `group` to list only one customer group's channels. It only reads: to add a channel use create_channel_connect_link; channels are removed in the Hookpost app.

group.description: Optional. A customer group id from list_customer_groups; only the channels of that group are returned. Leave out to list every channel.

tools.name: create_channel_connect_link
tools.description: Creates a link that connects a new social media account to this Hookpost workspace. Use this when the user wants to add a channel, or when list_channels shows no channel for the platform they want to post to. Give the returned url to the user: opening it in a browser takes them to the platform's own sign-in and approval screen, and the channel is added once they approve. Nothing is connected until the user opens the link and approves, so call list_channels afterwards to get the new channel id. The link works for 24 hours and can be opened more than once. It cannot reconnect an existing channel. Platforms that need a server address, typed credentials, a wallet or the browser extension are added in the Hookpost app; for those the result has an error that says so.

platform.description: Platform identifier of the network to connect, one of: x, linkedin, instagram, instagram-standalone, facebook, threads, youtube, tiktok, pinterest, discord, slack.

tools.name: list_customer_groups
tools.description: Lists the customer groups of this Hookpost workspace, each with its id and name. A customer group is a set of channels kept together for one client or brand. Use this when the user names a client, brand or customer, to get the group id that list_channels and list_posts take as a filter. It only reads. A workspace that has no customer groups returns an empty list; groups are managed in the Hookpost app.

tools.name: get_platform_post_rules
tools.description: Returns what a post has to satisfy on one social platform: its posting rules as text, the maximum post length, and each setting a post there takes (name, type, whether it is needed, allowed values, and the lookup tool that lists its values, if any). Use this when you are about to call create_post or update_post_settings, once for each platform involved. Pass the settings to create_post as one object with "platform" set to this platform. The answer is fixed data about the platform: it reads nothing from the user's accounts and changes nothing. An unknown platform returns empty rules and no settings.

isPremium.description: True only when the channel is an X account with X Premium, which has a higher length limit. False for every other platform, and when unsure.

platform.description: Platform identifier of the channel, as list_channels returns it in "platform". One of: x, linkedin, linkedin-page, instagram, instagram-standalone, facebook, threads, youtube, gmb, tiktok, tiktok-business, pinterest, dribbble, discord, slack, kick, twitch, mastodon, bluesky, lemmy, wrapcast, telegram, nostr, vk, medium, devto, hashnode, wordpress, listmonk, moltbook, whop, skool, mewe, tumblr

tools.name: list_pinterest_boards
tools.description: Lists the boards of one connected Pinterest account, with the id and name of each. Use this when you are about to call create_post or update_post_settings for a Pinterest channel: every pin needs the id of a board. It only reads from Pinterest and changes nothing. An empty list means the account has no boards yet, or its sign-in has expired.

channelId.description: Id of a Pinterest channel, from list_channels ("id")

tools.name: list_slack_channels
tools.description: Lists the public and private channels of one connected Slack workspace, with the id and name of each. Use this when you are about to call create_post or update_post_settings for a Slack channel: every Slack post needs the id of the channel it goes to. It only reads from Slack and changes nothing. Hookpost can post only in channels its Slack app was added to.

channelId.description: Id of a Slack channel, from list_channels ("id")

tools.name: list_discord_channels
tools.description: Lists the text, announcement and forum channels of one connected Discord server, with the id and name of each. Use this when you are about to call create_post or update_post_settings for a Discord channel: every Discord post needs the id of the channel it goes to. It only reads from Discord and changes nothing.

channelId.description: Id of a Discord channel, from list_channels ("id")

tools.name: list_wordpress_post_options
tools.description: Lists, for one connected WordPress site, its post types, categories and tags, with the id and name of each (up to 100 categories and 100 tags). Use this when you are about to call create_post or update_post_settings for a WordPress channel: every post needs a post type id, and categories and tags are given by id. It only reads from the site and changes nothing.

channelId.description: Id of a WordPress channel, from list_channels ("id")

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Creates one or more posts on the user's connected channels: saved as a draft, scheduled for a date and time, or published now. Use this when the user asks to draft, schedule, queue or publish a social media post. First get the channel ids from list_channels and call get_platform_post_rules for each platform, for its length limit and required settings. Ids for settings come from list_pinterest_boards, list_slack_channels, list_discord_channels and list_wordpress_post_options. A scheduled or published post goes out on the social network, where it is public and these tools cannot withdraw it, so use type "schedule" or "now" only when the user asked for that; type "draft" only saves the post in Hookpost. Each item in socialPost is one post on one channel. In postsAndComments the first entry is the post and each later entry is a follow-up under it: a thread reply on X, Threads and Bluesky, a comment on other platforms. For example, one LinkedIn post with one comment is one socialPost item with two postsAndComments entries. This tool does not edit or delete existing posts, and calling it again with the same input creates the posts again. Returns the id of each post created with its channel id and a previewUrl: a page that shows the post as it will look, which the user can open or send to someone to review it. If validation fails, nothing is created and output.errors says what to fix.

remindMe.description: Optional. True only when the user wants to post it themselves, for example to add music in the Instagram, TikTok or YouTube app: at the scheduled time Hookpost emails them the media and caption and does not publish. Leave out to publish automatically.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: Lists the posts of this Hookpost workspace whose publish date is between startDate and endDate (UTC), in every state: scheduled, draft, published or failed. Use this when the user asks what is planned or what went out, to find days with nothing scheduled, or to get the post id that update_post_settings needs. For every upcoming post, pass a window from now to a year ahead. Each post comes with its id, publish date, state, text, channel and current platform settings. Set includeAttachments to true to also get each post's media; those path values can be passed to create_post as attachments, so media already in Hookpost needs no new upload. It only reads. Posts cannot be deleted with these tools; the user deletes them in the Hookpost app.

startDate.description: Start of the window (UTC), for example 2026-07-20T00:00:00

endDate.description: End of the window (UTC), for example 2026-08-20T00:00:00

customer.description: Optional. A customer group id from list_customer_groups; only posts on the channels of that group are returned.

includeAttachments.description: Optional. True to also return the media of each post, for example to repeat a post with its media on another channel. Left out, no media is returned.

tools.name: update_post_settings
tools.description: Changes the platform settings of one existing post that has not been published yet (a draft or a scheduled post), for example its Pinterest board or YouTube title. Use this when the user wants to change such a setting on a post that already exists. Get the post id from list_posts and the settings of its platform from get_platform_post_rules; ids of Pinterest boards, Slack or Discord channels and WordPress post types, categories and tags come from list_pinterest_boards, list_slack_channels, list_discord_channels and list_wordpress_post_options. Only the settings you pass change, and their old values are overwritten; the text, the media and the publish date stay as they are. It cannot change a published post, edit text or dates, or delete a post. Returns the post id and its publish date, or output.errors saying what to fix.

tools.name: update_post_media
tools.description: Replaces the images or videos of one existing post that has not been published yet (a draft or a scheduled post). Use this when the user wants to swap, add or remove the media of such a post without creating it again. Get the post id from list_posts (set includeAttachments to see the current media) and new media URLs from upload_media_from_url. The list you pass is the full new list: media left out is removed, and an empty list removes all media. Only the media of the main post changes; its text, settings, publish date and follow-up comments stay as they are. Returns the post id and its publish date, or output.errors saying what to fix.

id.description: Id of the post to change, from list_posts ("id")

attachments.description: The full new list of media URLs in Hookpost, in order, for example the path values from upload_media_from_url or list_posts. An empty list removes all media.

tools.name: upload_media_from_url
tools.description: Copies one image or video from a public URL into this workspace's Hookpost media library and returns its id and path. Use this when the user gives a link to an image or video they want in a post, then pass the returned path to create_post as an attachment: a post only takes media stored in Hookpost. Not needed for media that list_posts already returned with a path. The file type is read from the file itself; an unsupported type, a file over the size limit or a URL that cannot be fetched returns error and stores nothing. Each call stores a new copy.

url.description: Public http or https URL of the image or video to copy, for example https://example.com/photo.jpg
